description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against tables staged on a DataCanvas by openmeteo_get_forecast, openmeteo_get_historical, openmeteo_get_marine, openmeteo_get_air_quality, openmeteo_get_ensemble, openmeteo_get_flood, or openmeteo_get_climate. Pass the canvas_id returned when any of those tools spills (truncated: true), and reference the exact table_name those tools return alongside it. Call openmeteo_dataframe_describe to list staged tables and their columns when you need to discover names. Returns up to 100 leading rows — fewer when wide rows would pass the 80,000-character inline ceiling — plus row_count — exact, or a lower bound flagged by count_error when counting fails or runs past 5 seconds; page the rest with LIMIT / OFFSET.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by openmeteo_get_forecast, openmeteo_get_historical, openmeteo_get_marine, openmeteo_get_air_quality, openmeteo_get_ensemble, openmeteo_get_flood, or openmeteo_get_climate when truncated: true.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT statement. Reference table names from openmeteo_dataframe_describe. Example: SELECT AVG(temperature_2m) AS avg_temp, strftime(time, '%Y-%m') AS month FROM spilled_abc123 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

name: openmeteo_dataframe_query

count_error.description: Present only when counting the full result failed after its rows were read — the failure reason (e.g. sql_execution_error, or count_timeout when counting ran past 5 seconds). The rows are still valid; row_count is then a lower bound.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_not_enabled`: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or has expired under its 24 h sliding TTL. `system_catalog_access`: The SQL references a system catalog such as information_schema, sqlite_master, pg_catalog, or a duckdb_*() function. `missing_table`: The SQL references a table that is not staged on this canvas — a mistyped name, or one that expired (24 h sliding TTL) or was dropped. `row_too_large`: The first result row alone cannot fit the 80,000-character inline ceiling, and values are never cut. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

row_count.description: Exact number of rows in the full result. When count_error is present, the total could not be counted and this is a lower bound: the rows the query confirmed exist.

rows.description: Leading result rows: at most 100, and fewer when the next row would take the response past its 80,000-character inline ceiling. Values are never cut. When row_count exceeds rows.length, continue by re-issuing the SQL with OFFSET <rows.length>, added to any OFFSET it already applies, with any LIMIT reduced by the same amount. Page under an ORDER BY: without one, DuckDB guarantees no row order between calls.

title: Openmeteo Dataframe Query
